_doc: Hexagon socket screw keys (L-shaped hex keys) and the tools that turn a fixing: what a key needs to reach a screw's head. Sizes by the key's width across its flats, each list in the same order as sizes. A fixing reads its key size from its thread's set (m3.head_key and the rest) and its reach from here. kind as in x1c.json.
name: hexkey

sizes.rule: Hex key sizes, across the flats (s nominal), in the order of the lists below
sizes.source: ISO 2936:2001 (assembly tools for screws and nuts, hexagon socket screw keys), as tabulated at https://amesweb.info/Tools/Hexagon-Socket-Screw-Key-Chart.aspx

corners.rule: A hex key's width across its corners, at least (e min), size by size: the round the key turns in, so the room a key needs across its axis
corners.source: ISO 2936:2001 (assembly tools for screws and nuts, hexagon socket screw keys), as tabulated at https://amesweb.info/Tools/Hexagon-Socket-Screw-Key-Chart.aspx

long_arm.rule: A standard hex key's long arm (l1), size by size: a key put in along the screw's axis by its long arm, turned by its short arm, needs this much clear over the head
long_arm.source: ISO 2936:2001 (assembly tools for screws and nuts, hexagon socket screw keys), standard series, as tabulated at https://amesweb.info/Tools/Hexagon-Socket-Screw-Key-Chart.aspx

short_arm.rule: A standard hex key's short arm (l2), size by size: the least a key can reach down to a head with, its long arm then swung round as the handle
short_arm.source: ISO 2936:2001 (assembly tools for screws and nuts, hexagon socket screw keys), standard series, as tabulated at https://amesweb.info/Tools/Hexagon-Socket-Screw-Key-Chart.aspx

ball_end_tilt.rule: How far off a screw's axis a ball-end hex key still turns it: a head the straight line cannot reach may be reached tilted this far. A ball end takes less torque than a straight key, so a screw only a ball end reaches is said
ball_end_tilt.source: Bondhus Balldriver keys, a 25 degree working angle as the maker's figure is given in sellers' listings: https://marssupply.com/Product/BON26554 (2.5 mm), https://www.pelicansalessupply.com/products/bondhus-balldriver-l-wrench-keys-5-mm-4-7-in-long. No standard covers ball ends

socket_wall.rule: The wall of a socket or ring spanner round a hexagon head, taken for the room a hexagon head needs round its corners: an estimate, no standard was read for it
socket_wall.source: A working figure of @rulecad/cad, to be measured on the sockets in use
